items.title: ServiceNow Has Lost About $59 Billion in Value in 14 Trading Days, Since a Report Where Revenue Beat
items.summary: ServiceNow fell 6.6% Tuesday and is down 38% since its October report, about $59 billion. Revenue beat that night. The one forecast that slipped, and the numbers in context.
